payload.rationale: Hard-gate id_integrity failures cannot be repaired within allowed patch constraints. (1) Deliverable IDs (e.g., M1-D1) are flagged as not matching required DL# format, but changing any existing /id value is disallowed. (2) Architecture option risk representation is flagged as referencing missing risks; fixing likely requires edits to /plan_package/architecture/options (a locked canonical section) and/or introducing new risk IDs (disallowed). (3) Resolving the stage-sequence mismatch would require editing /plan_package/requirements and /plan_package/acceptance_tests (both forbidden to modify). (4) Missing CNS11 would require adding a new ID-bearing constraint object, which is disallowed. Recommend reroute to schema/validator owners to align expected ID formats, risk representation, and stage model before attempting further patching.
